description: Checks the brain as an operator: a fact from the notes, a fact that needs a tool from an MCP server (used without asking, since it only looks), and a fact from the web that takes long enough for Stand to say so and carry on. Run with STAND_BRAIN=poc/heckler/operator-brain.json and --talk poc/heckler/short-talk.md.

after.label: fact that needs a tool
after.say: Where has the Juniper order got to?

after.label: fact from the web, which takes a while
after.say: Which version of the Swift programming language is the latest stable one?

after.label: the next question, while that one is still being looked up
after.say: And where does the name Stand come from?

after.label: a pause, for a late answer to arrive
after.say: Was there anything you were going to come back to?

goodbye.label: goodbye
goodbye.say: No more questions from us. Thank you.
